entities.name: Kakkazan
entities.description: A spirit on Kamigawa in the shape of an upright crocodile with ruby-colored scales.

entities.name: Bontu
entities.description: God of Amonkhet who bears a crocodile head; crocodiles are sacred to her.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: God of Amonkhet to whom crocodiles are sacred.

entities.name: Sultai Brood
entities.description: Tarkir clan that keeps living and undead crocodiles as guard dogs.
